_comment: ADAAAA-6032 (plan D) labeled identity-continuity eval set. Each arc models the same entity appearing across 60s windows (and, in the A4 arc, 30 min apart). windows[].tracks[].id is the GROUND-TRUTH entity label; trackId is what the tracker emitted (reassigned between windows on purpose). The harness drives the real server EntityIdentityResolver / LiveRunShared and checks: (1) continuity = every occurrence of a labeled entity resolves to ONE entityRef; (2) falseMerge = distinct labeled entities never share a ref; (3) the A4 red-card arc references the earlier yellow.

arcs.description: A4 headline: same player booked (yellow) at T and dismissed (red) at T+30 min. Same long-lived trackId A in both windows -> one entity; the red arc must reference the earlier yellow.
Track drops out (occlusion), reappears 5 s later with a REASSIGNED trackId, IoU-overlapping its last position -> the resolver must stitch both to one entity.
Same player seen in two windows 30 min apart under completely different trackIds, but both carry jersey #10 (the strong identity signal) -> resolves to j:10 in both.
A wide re-appearing track overlaps two KNOWN distinct entities -> ambiguous; must NOT be merged onto either (no fabricated identity).
Ambiguity call-out: same box 30 min apart with NO jersey and a brand-new trackId must NOT be force-merged on spatial proximity alone (would be a fabricated cross-window identity).
